notes.title: Qasir al-Wasat: International Edition is released!
notes.notes:
[img=http://qasirgame.com/images/FaridAlaham1080b.jpg][/img]

Now come, dear travelers! 

Know that today is the day. The planets are aligned and the right stars gaze down us. The doors of the wondrous palace, long hidden in between worlds, will once again open. 

Qasir al-Wasat is finally here and you can get it on the Store Page or our [url=http://qasirgame.com/#delve]Official Website[/url].

As usual, if you would like to support the project, give us a shout out through your favourite social media. You can find us on [url=https://twitter.com/qasirgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/anightinbetween]Facebook[/url] and [url=http://www.qasirgame.tumblr.com/]Tumblr[/url].

notes.title: Qasir al-Wasat is coming January 19 2016
notes.notes:
This week we would like to hand you a special letter, delivered in a blue velvet envelope, and containing distinguished news:
[h1]The game will be available for PC, Mac and Linux in about one month![/h1]

Watch the teaser now:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MAVjuOhDWkA
And you can now check our gorgeous new website: [url=www.qasirgame.com]qasirgame.com[/url]

notes.title: SOON
notes.notes:
[img]http://qasirgame.com/images/Update20151016800c.jpg[/img]

Greetings, travellers! ːmakhorː

We have some great news! Qasir al-Wasat: Intl Edition will be releasing pretty soon, still during 2015.

To keep us up to speed we'll be releasing some crunchy newsletters pretty soon, and you can subscribe for them [b][url=http://qasirgame.com/newsletter]here![/url][/b]


Right now we're on the finishing touches for localizations (seven languages!) and the game is finally gold, meaning we just have a couple of QA rounds before launch.

Thanks to everyone who patiently waited for this new version, we hope you'll enjoy it. <З ːmakhorjoyː

notes.title: Dear Desura Owners, your keys are available!
notes.notes:
This is an important announcement to everyone who purchased Qasir al-Wasat on Desura, the Groupees Build a Bundle 4 or the Super BR Jam.

To everyone that has the game activated on Desura, you can hold on to your Steam key [url=http://www.desura.com/games/qasir-al-wasat/keys/][b]here[/b][/url] (you need to be logged on Desura).

You can also redeem your key by going to your collection on Desura and checking the link "Your Keys" for Qasir al-Wasat.

The game is currently not playable on Steam, but we strongly recommend everyone to grab your keys and redeem them right now, considering the murky future of Desura.

Thanks for your earlier support and for your patience.
